title: Ring the Bells of Heaven
description: Ring the Bells of Heaven in Tonic Solfa to RING THE BELLS: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: William O. Cushing wrote the words in 1870 to a melody by George F. Root.
underlay: Ring the bells of heav-en! There is joy to-day, For a soul, re-turn-ing from the wild! See, the Fa-ther meets him out up-on the way, Wel-com-ing His wea-ry, wan-d’ring child. Glo-ry! Glo-ry! How the an-gels sing: Glo-ry! Glo-ry! How the loud harps ring! ’Tis the ran-somed ar-my, like a might-y sea, Peal-ing forth the an-them of the free.

lines: For a soul, returning from the wild!
See, the Father meets him out upon the way,

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Glory! Glory! How the angels sing:
Glory! Glory! How the loud harps ring!
’Tis the ransomed army, like a mighty sea,
Pealing forth the anthem of the free.
For the wanderer now is reconciled;
Yes, a soul is rescued from his sinful way,
And is born anew, a ransomed child.
Angels, swell the glad triumphant strain!
Tell the joyful tidings, bear it far away!
For a precious soul is born again.
